import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

repo = Path('/home/brittonr/git/aspen-worktrees/guided-goal-completion-20261015')
evidence = repo / 'evidence/cairn-source-remediation-2026-10-15/attempt-19-shared-scheduler-source-acceptance'
producer_binary = shutil.which('cargo-octet')
if os.environ.get('IN_NIX_SHELL') not in ('pure', 'impure') or producer_binary is None:
    raise RuntimeError('Required catalogued Nix dev shell is absent')
producer = Path(producer_binary).resolve(strict=True).parent.parent
environment = os.environ.copy()
environment['PATH'] = str(producer / 'bin') + os.pathsep + environment['PATH']
workspace = 'target/octet-scheduler-cohort19-workspace'
library = 'target/octet-scheduler-cohort19-library'
ledger = 'target/octet-scheduler-cohort19-ledger'


def run(name, argv):
    destination = evidence / (name + '.json')
    if destination.exists():
        raise RuntimeError(f'Preserving existing execution record: {destination}')
    recorded = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(Path(__file__).with_name('record-command.py')),
                              str(destination), *argv], cwd=repo, env=environment,
                              capture_output=True, text=True)
    if not destination.is_file():
        raise RuntimeError(f'Command recorder failed: {recorded.stderr}')
    record = json.loads(destination.read_text())
    print(json.dumps({'record': destination.name, 'exit_code': record['exit_code'],
                      'elapsed_seconds': record['elapsed_seconds']}), flush=True)
    if record['exit_code'] != 0 or record['timed_out']:
        print(record['stdout'][-10000:], flush=True)
        print(record['stderr'][-16000:], file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
        raise SystemExit(record['exit_code'] or 1)
    return record


run('actual-rust-toolchain', ['rustc', '--version', '--verbose'])
run('focused-core-fabric-time', ['cargo', 'test', '--offline', '--locked', '-p', 'molten-core', '--lib', '--', 'fabric_time'])
run('focused-shell-fabric-time', ['cargo', 'test', '--offline', '--locked', '-p', 'molten', '--lib', '--', 'fabric_time'])

for name, args, directory in [
    ('ordered-octet-workspace', [], workspace),
    ('ordered-octet-library', ['-p', 'molten'], library),
]:
    argv = ['cargo', 'octet', 'check', *args, '--artifact-dir', directory]
    if args:
        argv += ['--', '--lib']
    run(name, argv)
    status = json.loads((repo / directory / 'status.json').read_text())
    if status['status'] != 'clean' or any(status[key] for key in ('total_findings', 'warning_findings', 'error_findings')):
        raise RuntimeError(f'Strict source acceptance rejects producer status: {status}')

sources = (evidence / 'source-corpus-final-paths.txt').read_text().splitlines()
if not sources or sources != sorted(sources) or len(sources) != len(set(sources)):
    raise RuntimeError('Object corpus must be the retained complete deterministic source list')
corpus = workspace + '/object-corpus-receipt.json'
run('ordered-object-corpus', ['cargo', 'octet', 'object', 'corpus', 'receipt', '--output', corpus, *sources])
cli = ['cargo', 'run', '--offline', '--locked', '--', 'test', 'octet']
run('ordered-artifact-import', [*cli, 'artifacts', 'import', '--artifacts', workspace,
    '--ledger', ledger, '--receipt-out', str(evidence / 'ordered-artifact-ledger-receipt.preserves')])
gate = run('ordered-strict-ci-gate', [*cli, 'gate', '--artifacts', workspace,
    '--profile', 'strict-ci', '--receipt-out', str(evidence / 'ordered-strict-ci-gate.preserves')])
if '<decision \"pass\">' not in (evidence / 'ordered-strict-ci-gate.preserves').read_text():
    raise RuntimeError('Strict source gate did not report a passing decision')
run('ordered-remediation-plan', [*cli, 'remediation', 'plan', '--artifacts', workspace,
    '--lib-artifacts', library, '--focused-object-corpus', corpus,
    '--receipt-out', str(evidence / 'ordered-remediation-plan.preserves')])

run('ordered-workspace-all-targets', ['cargo', 'test', '--offline', '--locked', '--workspace', '--all-targets'])
run('ordered-workspace-doctests', ['cargo', 'test', '--offline', '--locked', '--workspace', '--doc'])
features = 'doltlite-oracle,executable-extents,profiler-perf,profiler-alloc,world-snapshot-vm-cohort'
run('ordered-enabled-feature-tests', ['cargo', 'test', '--offline', '--locked', '--workspace', '--all-targets', '--features', features])
run('ordered-disabled-profiler-tests', ['cargo', 'test', '--offline', '--locked', '--workspace', '--all-targets', '--features', 'profiler-disabled'])
for name, selectors in [('default', []), ('enabled', ['--features', features]), ('disabled', ['--features', 'profiler-disabled'])]:
    run('ordered-' + name + '-clippy', ['cargo', 'clippy', '--offline', '--locked', '--workspace', '--all-targets', *selectors, '--', '-D', 'warnings'])
run('ordered-format-check', ['cargo', 'fmt', '--all', '--check'])
run('ordered-relevant-nix-checks', ['nix', 'build', '--no-update-lock-file', '--no-link', '-L',
    '.#checks.x86_64-linux.nextest', '.#checks.x86_64-linux.clippy', '.#checks.x86_64-linux.nextest-config'])
run('ordered-repository-nix-gate', ['nix', 'flake', 'check', '--no-update-lock-file', '-L', '.'])
run('ordered-strict-cairn-validation', ['/nix/store/hgx9knp5q29b0lfw7isvc5ba1caayyjj-cairn-0.1.0/bin/cairn',
    'validate', '--root', '.', '--policy', '/nix/store/xpl4byf12mpb7lda9zf83z9grc0na189-source/cairn-policy/generated/cairn-policy.json', '--strict'])

import datetime
import json
import os
import signal
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

output, *argv = sys.argv[1:]
started = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
before = time.monotonic()
child = subprocess.Popen(argv, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, start_new_session=True)
timed_out = False
try:
    stdout, stderr = child.communicate(timeout=3500)
except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
    timed_out = True
    os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
    try:
        stdout, stderr = child.communicate(timeout=10)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
        stdout, stderr = child.communicate()
result = {'argv': argv, 'cwd': os.getcwd(), 'started_at': started,
          'elapsed_seconds': round(time.monotonic()-before, 3), 'exit_code': child.returncode,
          'timed_out': timed_out, 'stdout': stdout, 'stderr': stderr,
          'environment': {'IN_NIX_SHELL': os.environ.get('IN_NIX_SHELL'),
                          'CARGO_TARGET_DIR': os.environ.get('CARGO_TARGET_DIR')}}
Path(output).write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2)+'\n')
print(stdout[-14000:], end='')
print(stderr[-12000:], end='', file=sys.stderr)
print(json.dumps({'record': output, 'exit_code': child.returncode, 'seconds': result['elapsed_seconds']}))
sys.exit(child.returncode if child.returncode >= 0 else 128-child.returncode)
